selection: The same previously designated lowest-numbered participant, after observing the 04 and 05 rendered results. No angle-guided image had been generated for this participant at lock. Earlier 01 category, pre-diffusion residual and native generator results were known.
method: Use the same once-fitted generic angular gain, projected directions, 32-photo radius, 512-class object readout, three arms, prompt, four SDXL steps and per-row seeds from the 04/05 image experiment. One generated output per query and arm. No refits.
primary: Report CLIP-L/14 full-vocabulary naming, CLIP and DINOv2-S/14 paired assignment on the correctly named same-object, same-fold pairs against both the prior and wrong EEG, with all 240 queries in the within-class ten-photo test. Report positive and negative outcomes.
